title: ctrl+c quits the interface while a long sleep runs
acceptance: a drive presses ctrl+c during a 60 second sleep and the interface exits within 3 s, the host gone 10 s later
reason: Committed. Console run: the interface exits 1.9 s after the press, the host is gone 4.8 s later. I did not drive it in a real terminal; check it at the cut. The member stop is TOFU-2210. Flows 10/10 at 64b0e2fa.

title: the interface keeps a window of the feed rather than every event
acceptance: a seeded nine day session open for 20 minutes stays within 10% of its memory at minute 2, and the first message still shows
reason: 9b71c2d4. Driven on the large seed: 81-97 MB against 300-322, search gives 3 results, 40 page-downs with no jump. Open: the disk count on first visit, a rare short id clash, and a verdict line lost on read back. flows 10/10 pass at 7a2e44c0

title: a retry phrased with again is not read as a correction
acceptance: a learn scan over a session with a retry request and two agreeing corrections makes no finding from the retry
reason: e19a7c05: again counts only beside you in the same clause. Rerun on the scratch session: before, a rule from the retry; after, rules from the two corrections only. learn packages pass. Open: a polite retry phrased as a question still reads as a correction.

title: learn makes a rule only from corrections that agree
acceptance: a learn scan over a session with a one-off request and two agreeing corrections makes a rule only from the corrections
reason: 2c8f6b30: corrections group only when three shared words sit within two neighbouring clauses. Rerun on the scratch session: the rule now comes from the two corrections only. learn packages pass. Open: the corrected pattern still marks a retry as a correction, ticketed.

title: a running sub-agent's clock moves while it sits inside one call
acceptance: the clock test passes at the fix and fails before it, and a cassette drive shows the clock advancing
reason: Committed. Cause: a shared slice let the clock write into the recorded event; the fix copies the rows. The clock test passes and failed before. Frame time 2.1 ms at 450 sub-agents, unchanged. Open: one cassette showed spawning for 90 s on an unfinished reply, not confirmed.

title: a sub-agent's one hour cap counts only its own work
acceptance: a sub-agent that waits on the lead past a shortened cap keeps running and ends on its own work time
reason: Committed. The cap now subtracts time spent waiting on the lead or the person. Driven on a scratch clone with a 2 s cap: before, cut at 4.6 s; after, both commands run and it stops at 6.1 s. Open: no test covers a wait inside the ask tool.

title: a sub-agent that dies with the app is marked dead and its report survives
acceptance: kill the app with three sub-agents running and reopen: they show as stopped by the restart and the lead gets their reports
reason: Committed. On reopen each sub-agent with no end gets an errored end and its report reaches the lead. Driven by hand on a real session killed mid-write. Open: resuming the same session in the same process while its sub-agents still run would mark them dead, which is not guarded.

title: a refused shell write costs one request instead of three
acceptance: three alternating live runs per arm show fewer conversation requests after the first refusal than before
reason: Accepted as 5d0a9e17. A refused shell write now says nothing ran and names the edit call to use instead. Requests median 15 to 5, refusals 2 to 1. Open: a heredoc still wrote source without a refusal (TOFU-2188).

title: a script the lead runs cannot write source past the line budget
acceptance: a script that writes source is charged to the budget and refused once it is spent, shown with the diff
reason: Committed. A script's changed lines are charged to the 200 line budget and refused once it is spent. internal/turn passes, flows 8 of 8 stamped; the drive shows 120 then 210 spent and the script refused. Open: TOFU-2190.

title: a follower's steering and answers reach the holder
acceptance: steering, a question answer and a memory answer typed in a follower all reach the holder's turn
reason: Committed 7f3e1b22: steer, send-now, drop, question answers and memory answers are forwarded to the holder; red on the old binary, passing on this one. Open: TOFU-2195. bench/treewide passes on a clean clone, flows 8 of 8.

title: a second app attaches to a running session as a live follower
acceptance: a second terminal resuming a running session streams the turn live and forwards prompts to the holder
reason: Committed 0e6a4d58. A second process that opens a held session follows it over a local socket and takes the lock 12 ms after the holder dies. Product packages pass on a clean clone, one cron test flaky under load (TOFU-2197). Follow-ups: TOFU-2195.

title: sub-agent transitions are recorded with their reasons
acceptance: a cassette run that spawns, reviews, reopens and accepts a child lists four transition events in order
reason: 61c2a0f9. Transitions recorded as typed notices; the trace showed spawned, reviewed, reopened with its reason, reviewed, accepted. Follow-ups TOFU-2212. Flows 10/10 at 3b9e7d10.

title: the board refuses done while a part is open
acceptance: a move to done with an unmet acceptance line is refused naming that line
reason: Commit 1a7c3f90. Done refuses a line with no evidence and a reason that names an open part; new refuses a ticket missing its drafted sections. Driven in a fresh home with the classifier bound; flows 10 of 10. Calibrating the threshold is TOFU-2240.

title: a commit under apps only does not void the flows stamp
acceptance: after stamping, a commit that touches only apps lets a done move pass without a new run
reason: 8d3b5e21. Checked by me: the tree hash without apps matches for both commits. guard and stamp tests pass, the drive is in the log. The next gated done move still needs one flows run under the new key.

title: session info carries the session it was forked from
acceptance: session info over serve returns the parent session id for a forked session
reason: b42e9c07: session info carries the parent; driven over serve, it returns the parent id and the schema lists it. It reaches the desktop app at the next cut, and the app still has to repin its schema.

title: the rivals bench covers a project with a board
acceptance: one rivals arm runs with a board on and scores 10 of 10 without stopping on a board rule
reason: 3e8a1d64. A rivals run with the board on scored 5 of 5 hidden and 5 of 5 rubric in 12 requests and 41 s, no board stop. Built on the installed release, not on HEAD.

title: panic handling for the host and the shells

reason: Committed. The safe package wraps every goroutine start in the host and the shells; watchers restart with backoff. host, shell and turn packages pass; flows 8 of 8 stamped. One warm typecheck test is flaky on its own, 1 of 3, filed.

title: a read sends what the model needs and notes a repeat
acceptance: three alternating live runs per arm show fewer requests and less input with full quality
reason: Accepted after round 3. A read with no range returns what it did before; a third identical read of an unchanged file gets a note to narrow. Aimed at loops that re-read the same paths; no bench file is long enough to show a gain. Read and spawn tests pass on a clean copy.

reason: f5c20b8e. Real session against the base: open 81/60 vs 80/97 ms, walk 73.9 vs 76.1 s, slowest page 2401 vs 2410 ms, heap 512 vs 630 MB. Flows 10 of 10 pass on a clean clone. Card redraw is TOFU-2236.

The first turn after a resume reads 0.98 from cache against 0.00. Flows pass at the commit.
